name: Cloud Nine
tagline: A sunny painted sky over a green hill: letters ride a curve, app cards float in 3D, words blur in like breath.
description: A light, optimistic product language set in one painted landscape: a bright blue sky with soft clouds over a rolling green hill, tiny petals drifting through. White rounded type arrives letter by letter along a wave, squashes into a block that becomes a floating stack of rounded app cards tilting in perspective, their screens swapping while they hover. A depth-of-field whip blurs them away, the camera drifts up into open sky and the next line blurs in word by word. One continuous shot, no cuts.
bestFor: short vertical and square social posts

signature: wave-in: letters fly in along a curved path one by one and settle onto the baseline
squash into cards: the settled word compresses into a block that unfolds as a floating 3D stack of app cards
focus whip: the subject sweeps sideways out of the plane of focus, going soft and big, revealing open sky

camera: One continuous painted world. The camera floats: a slow drift and gentle tilt up from hill to open sky between beats, a slight dolly toward the hero cards. Depth of field is the main tool: the subject is sharp, the hill and far clouds are soft, and objects leave the frame by going out of focus.

texture.notes: Soft painted sky: a vertical gradient from deeper blue at the top to haze near the horizon, puffy white clouds with soft edges, a rolling green hill with lighter highlights and tiny flecks of flowers. Small petals or leaves drift slowly through the sky.

lighting: Bright midday sun from the upper left: a soft lens glow in the top corner, cards lit evenly with soft, diffuse drop shadows below them.
sound: Light and airy: a soft pluck or bell per letter, a gentle whoosh for the card fly-in and the focus whip, a warm pad underneath, a little birdsong or breeze.

beats.label: Letters wave in over the hill
Word squashes into a floating card stack
A line blurs in word by word

motionSummary: Moves like a daydream: letters ride a breeze onto the line, a word folds into a stack of floating app cards, and everything leaves by drifting out of focus into open sky.

composition: one subject (a word, a line or a card stack) slightly above centre, the hill along the bottom third, sky everywhere else
the world stays put; the camera drifts and the subject floats
lots of air: never more than one line or one stack at a time
visual.shapeLanguage: soft and rounded: generous corner radius on cards (≈ 12 % of their width), thin white card borders, puffy clouds, rolling hill curves; no hard edges
visual.contrast: bright high-key: white type and cards against mid blue sky, green hill as the base; the only dark element is a photo or dark screen inside one card

grammar.pacing: calm and continuous: one idea every 1.5–2.5 s, carried by floating moves rather than cuts
grammar.rhythm: letter-by-letter and word-by-word: each letter or word lands 2–4 f after the last, like a melody
grammar.easing: soft out ([0.22,1,0.36,1]) for arrivals, smooth float ([0.37,0,0.63,1]) for hovering, a gentle spring for letters landing; never linear, never snappy
grammar.acceleration: fast in, long soft landing; floating objects never fully stop (2–6 px bob, 1–3° sway)
movement: letters flying in along a curve with rotation
words blurring in one by one
grammar.density: low: one subject, a few petals
grammar.holds: soft holds of 15–30 f where the subject keeps floating

transitionPresets.name: Wave in
transitionPresets.build: each letter starts below and to the left on a curved path (rotated 30–60°, scaled 0.4, blurred 6 px), then follows the curve up onto the baseline with a gentle spring; 2–3 f stagger per letter

transitionPresets.name: Squash into cards
transitionPresets.build: the settled word squashes horizontally (scaleX 1 → 0.2) and blurs into a rounded white block; the block becomes the front card and two cards slide out behind it in 3D, fanned and tilted
transitionPresets.sound: a soft whoosh into a tap

transitionPresets.name: Focus whip
transitionPresets.build: the subject accelerates sideways and toward the camera (scale 1 → 1.4, x −40 %) while blur rises 0 → 24 px; the background stays sharp, so it reads as leaving the focal plane

transitionPresets.name: Sky drift
transitionPresets.build: the camera tilts up (the hill sinks 20–30 % and the clouds move slower than the hill), leaving open sky for the next line

transitionPresets.name: Blur in words
transitionPresets.build: each word fades in from blur 12 px and opacity 0, rising 10 px, 4–6 f apart; a new line replaces the old one by blurring out as the next blurs in at the same place

transitionPresets.name: Card swap
transitionPresets.build: the card stays, its screen content slides or crossfades to the next UI while the stack keeps hovering

archetypes.composition: one white word or short phrase above the hill, slightly above centre
archetypes.elements: white display type with a soft shadow, a few drifting petals
archetypes.motion: letters wave in along a curve and settle with a spring

archetypes.name: Floating card stack
archetypes.purpose: the product: its screens as tangible objects
archetypes.composition: three rounded cards fanned in 3D (light UI, dark photo, bright UI), centred in the sky above the hill
archetypes.elements: app screens on rounded cards with thin white borders and soft drop shadows
archetypes.motion: the stack hovers and sways, tilts toward camera, screens swap

archetypes.name: Open sky
archetypes.composition: sky and clouds only, the hill sinking out of frame

archetypes.name: Breath line
archetypes.purpose: the message, one line at a time
archetypes.composition: a single centred line of white text in open sky
archetypes.motion: words blur in one by one, line holds and floats up slightly, then blurs out as the next arrives

archetypes.name: Hill lockup
archetypes.purpose: the name and the call to action
archetypes.composition: the logo or app icon on a rounded tile above the hill, the name under it

archetypes.motion: the icon card floats down into place, the name blurs in
archetypes.camera: tilt back down to the hill

beats.motion: words blur in, one line replaces another
icon floats down above the hill

sequence.cutRhythm: no cuts: one continuous shot; letters and words land on beats, larger moves ride phrases

scenes.action: 'Plan less' waves in letter by letter over the hill
the word squashes into a white card; a calendar card and a photo card fan out behind; the front screen swaps to a focus timer
the stack whips left out of focus; the camera tilts up into clouds
'Your week, sorted' blurs in word by word, then 'without the stress'
the camera settles back on the hill; the app icon floats down, the name blurs in under it

elements.text: white, sentence case, short; display face for hooks (letters waving in), text face for lines (words blurring in); a soft shadow for legibility on light sky
elements.logo: on a rounded white tile, floating above the hill at the end
elements.icons: rounded app-icon tiles that float and bob
elements.images: inside rounded cards only (a photo screen in the stack), never full-bleed
elements.ui: real screens on rounded cards, fanned in a 3D stack, swapping content
elements.shapes: rounded cards, clouds, the hill; nothing angular
elements.background: the painted sky and hill, always present, moved only by the camera
elements.particles: a few petals or leaves drifting and turning slowly

audio.sync: letters and words land on notes of a melody or soft hats; the card stack arrives on a phrase start; the focus whip on a swell
audio.sfx: soft plucks for letters, bells for words, gentle whooshes for cards and focus whips, a breeze and light birdsong under everything
